versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רְאוּבֵ֤ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ לֵוִ֣י וִיהוּדָ֔ה יִשָׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבֻלֽוּן׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Israel: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar, Zebulom,

versos.hebraico: דָּ֚ן יוֹסֵ֣ף וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃ס

controles.web: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
controles.kjv: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
controles.livre: Dã, José, Benjamim, Naftali, Gade, e Aser.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֤ר וְאוֹנָן֙ וְשֵׁלָ֔ה שְׁלוֹשָׁה֙ נ֣וֹלַד ל֔וֹ מִבַּת־שׁ֖וּעַ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית וַיְהִ֞י עֵ֣ר׀ בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֗ה רַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵֽהוּ׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahweh; and he killed him.
controles.kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Judá foram: Er, Onã, e Selá. Estes três lhe nasceram de Bete-Suá, Cananeia. E Er, primogênito, de Judá, foi mau diante do Senhor, que o matou.

versos.hebraico: וְתָמָר֙ כַּלָּת֔וֹ יָ֥לְדָה לּ֖וֹ אֶת־פֶּ֣רֶץ וְאֶת־זָ֑רַח כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
controles.kjv: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
controles.livre: E Tamar, sua nora, lhe deu à luz Perez e a Zerá. Todos os filhos de Judá foram cinco.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְחָמֽוּל׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.
controles.kjv: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Perez: Hezrom e Hamul.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י זֶ֗רַח זִ֠מְרִי וְאֵיתָ֧ן וְהֵימָ֛ן וְכַלְכֹּ֥ל וָדָ֖רַע כֻּלָּ֥ם חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Zerá: Zinri, Etã, Hemã, e Calcol, e Darda; cinco ao todo.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י כַּרְמִ֑י עָכָר֙ עוֹכֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַ֖ל בַּחֵֽרֶם׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
controles.livre: O filho de Carmi foi Acar, o perturbador de Israel, porque transgrediu naquilo que estava separado por maldiçãos.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י אֵיתָ֖ן עֲזַרְיָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Ethan: Azariah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
controles.livre: O filho de Etã foi Azarias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י חֶצְר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נוֹלַד־ל֑וֹ אֶת־יְרַחְמְאֵ֥ל וְאֶת־רָ֖ם וְאֶת־כְּלוּבָֽי׃

controles.web: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
controles.kjv: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
controles.livre: Os filhos que nasceram a Hezrom foram: Jerameel, Rão, e Quelubai.

versos.hebraico: וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עַמִּינָדָ֑ב וְעַמִּינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נַחְשׁ֔וֹן נְשִׂ֖יא בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
controles.kjv: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
controles.livre: E Rão gerou a Aminadabe; e Aminadabe gerou a Naasom, príncipe dos filhos de Judá;

versos.hebraico: וְנַחְשׁוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שַׂלְמָ֔א וְשַׂלְמָ֖א הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בֹּֽעַז׃

controles.web: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
controles.kjv: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
controles.livre: E Naasom gerou a Salmom, e Salmom gerou a Boaz;

versos.hebraico: וּבֹ֨עַז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עוֹבֵ֔ד וְעוֹבֵ֖ד הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יִשָֽׁי׃

controles.web: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
controles.kjv: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
controles.livre: E Boaz gerou a Obede, e Obede gerou a Jessé;

versos.hebraico: וְאִישַׁ֛י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בְּכֹר֖וֹ אֶת־אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַאֲבִינָדָב֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְשִׁמְעָ֖א הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃

controles.web: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
controles.kjv: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
controles.livre: E Jessé gerou a Eliabe, seu primogênito, e o segundo Abinadabe, o terceiro Simeia;

versos.hebraico: נְתַנְאֵל֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י רַדַּ֖י הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
controles.kjv: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
controles.livre: O quarto Natanael, o quinto Radai;

versos.hebraico: אֹ֚צֶם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י דָּוִ֖יד הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

controles.web: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
controles.kjv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
controles.livre: O sexto Ozém, o sétimo Davi;

versos.hebraico: ואחיתיהם צְרוּיָ֣ה וַאֲבִיגָ֑יִל וּבְנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֗ה אַבְשַׁ֛י וְיוֹאָ֥ב וַעֲשָׂה־אֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
controles.kjv: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
controles.livre: As irmãs dos quais foram Zeruia e Abigail. Os filhos de Zeruia foram três: Abisai, Joabe, e Asael.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־עֲמָשָׂ֑א וַאֲבִ֣י עֲמָשָׂ֔א יֶ֖תֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי׃

controles.web: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
controles.kjv: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
controles.livre: E Abigail deu à luz Amasa, cujo pai foi Jéter, o Ismaelita.

versos.hebraico: וְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־חֶצְר֗וֹן הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עֲזוּבָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־יְרִיע֑וֹת וְאֵ֣לֶּה בָנֶ֔יהָ יֵ֥שֶׁר וְשׁוֹבָ֖ב וְאַרְדּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
controles.kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
controles.livre: E Calebe filho de Hezrom gerou de sua mulher Azuba, e de Jeriote.  E os filhos dela foram: Jeser, Sobabe, e Ardom.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֖מָת עֲזוּבָ֑ה וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֤וֹ כָלֵב֙ אֶת־אֶפְרָ֔ת וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־חֽוּר׃

controles.web: Azubah died, and Caleb took to him Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
controles.kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
controles.livre: E Azuba morreu, e Calebe tmou por mulher a Efrate, a qual lhe gerou a Hur.

versos.hebraico: וְחוּר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אוּרִ֔י וְאוּרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בְּצַלְאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
controles.kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
controles.livre: E Hur gerou a Uri, e Uri gerou a Bezalel.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֤א חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֶל־בַּת־מָכִיר֙ אֲבִ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וְה֣וּא לְקָחָ֔הּ וְה֖וּא בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־שְׂגֽוּב׃

controles.web: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
controles.kjv: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
controles.livre: Depois Hezrom se deitou com a filha de Maquir, pai de Gileade, a qual ele tomou por esposa quando ele tinha sessenta anos, e ela lhe gerou a Segube.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂג֖וּב הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יָאִ֑יר וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

controles.web: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
controles.kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
controles.livre: E Segube gerou a Jair, que teve vinte e três cidades na terra de Gileade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר־וַ֠אֲרָם אֶת־חַוֺּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵאִתָּ֛ם אֶת־קְנָ֥ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כָּל־אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִי־גִלְעָֽד׃

controles.web: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
controles.kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
controles.livre: E Gesur e Arã tomaram deles as cidades de Jair, e a Quenate com suas aldeias, sessenta cidades. Todos estes foram filhos de Maquir, pai de Gileade.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחַ֥ר מוֹת־חֶצְר֖וֹן בְּכָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְאֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֽוֹעַ׃

controles.web: After that Hezron was dead in Caleb Ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
controles.kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb–ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
controles.livre: E depois da morte de Hezrom, em Calebe de Efrata, Abia mulher de Hezrom, lhe gerou a Asur, pai de Tecoa.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי־יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכ֥וֹר חֶצְר֖וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ רָ֑ם וּבוּנָ֥ה וָאֹ֛רֶן וָאֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Jerameel primogênito de Hezrom foram: Rão (seu primogênito), Buna, Orém, Ozém, e Aías.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּשְׁמָ֣הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אוֹנָֽם׃ס

controles.web: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
controles.kjv: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
controles.livre: Jerameel também teve outra mulher chamada Atara, que foi mãe de Onã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־רָ֖ם בְּכ֣וֹר יְרַחְמְאֵ֑ל מַ֥עַץ וְיָמִ֖ין וָעֵֽקֶר׃

controles.web: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Rão, primogênito de Jerameel, foram: Maaz, Jamim, e Equer.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־אוֹנָ֖ם שַׁמַּ֣י וְיָדָ֑ע וּבְנֵ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִישֽׁוּר׃

controles.web: The sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Onã foram: Samai, e Jada. E os filhos de Samai: Nadabe, e Abisur.

versos.hebraico: וְשֵׁ֛ם אֵ֥שֶׁת אֲבִישׁ֖וּר אֲבִיהָ֑יִל וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־אַחְבָּ֖ן וְאֶת־מוֹלִֽיד׃

controles.web: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
controles.kjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
controles.livre: E o nome da mulher de Abisur era Abiail, a qual lhe gerou a Abã e a Molide.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב סֶ֣לֶד וְאַפָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֥מָת סֶ֖לֶד לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Nadabe foram: Selede e Apaim. E Selede morreu sem filhos.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י אַפַּ֖יִם יִשְׁעִ֑י וּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׁעִי֙ שֵׁשָׁ֔ן וּבְנֵ֥י שֵׁשָׁ֖ן אַחְלָֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Appaim: Ishi. The sons of Ishi: Sheshan. The sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
controles.livre: E o filho de Apaim foi Isi; o filho de Isi foi Sesã; e o filho de Sesã foi Alai.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י יָדָע֙ אֲחִ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י יֶ֖תֶר וְיוֹנָתָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת יֶ֖תֶר לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Jada, irmão de Simmai, foram: Jéter e Jônatas. E Jéter morreu sem filhos.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹנָתָ֖ן פֶּ֣לֶת וְזָזָ֑א אֵ֥לֶּה הָי֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Jônatas foram: Pelete, e Zaza. Estes foram os filhos de Jerameel.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וּלְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן עֶ֥בֶד מִצְרִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ יַרְחָֽע׃

controles.web: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
controles.kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
controles.livre: E Sesã não teve filhos, mas somente filhas. E Sesã tinha um servo egípcio, cujo nome era Jará.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שֵׁשָׁ֧ן אֶת־בִּתּ֛וֹ לְיַרְחָ֥ע עַבְדּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־עַתָּֽי׃

controles.web: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
controles.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
controles.livre: Sesã deu sua filha a seu servo Jará, e ela lhe gerou a Atai.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתַּי֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נָתָ֔ן וְנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־זָבָֽד׃

controles.web: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
controles.kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
controles.livre: E Atai gerou a Natã, e Natã gerou a Zabade;

versos.hebraico: וְזָבָד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אֶפְלָ֔ל וְאֶפְלָ֖ל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עוֹבֵֽד׃

controles.web: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
controles.kjv: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
controles.livre: E Zabade gerou a Eflal, e Eflal gerou a Obede;

versos.hebraico: וְעוֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יֵה֔וּא וְיֵה֖וּא הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָֽה׃

controles.web: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
controles.kjv: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
controles.livre: E Obede gerou a Jeú, e Jeú gerou a Azarias;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲזַרְיָה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־חָ֔לֶץ וְחֶ֖לֶץ הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
controles.kjv: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
controles.livre: E Azarias gerou a Helez, Helez gerou a Eleasá;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶלְעָשָׂה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־סִֽסְמָ֔י וְסִסְמַ֖י הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁלּֽוּם׃

controles.web: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
controles.kjv: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
controles.livre: Eleasá gerou a Sismai, e Sismai gerou a Salum;

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יְקַמְיָ֔ה וִֽיקַמְיָ֖ה הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֱלִישָׁמָֽע׃

controles.web: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
controles.kjv: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
controles.livre: E Salum gerou a Jecamias, e Jecamias gerou a Elisama.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י כָלֵב֙ אֲחִ֣י יְרַחְמְאֵ֔ל מֵישָׁ֥ע בְּכֹר֖וֹ ה֣וּא אֲבִי־זִ֑יף וּבְנֵ֥י מָרֵשָׁ֖ה אֲבִ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
controles.kjv: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Calebe, irmão de Jerameel, foram: Messa seu primogênito, que foi o pai de Zife; e os filhos de Maressa, pai de Hebrom.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן קֹ֥רַח וְתַפֻּ֖חַ וְרֶ֥קֶם וָשָֽׁמַע׃

controles.web: The sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Hebrom foram: Corá, Tapua, Requém, e Sema.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֣מַע הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־רַ֖חַם אֲבִ֣י יָרְקֳעָ֑ם וְרֶ֖קֶם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁמָּֽי׃

controles.web: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
controles.kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
controles.livre: E Sema gerou a Raão, pai de Jorqueão; e Requém gerou a Samai.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־שַׁמַּ֖י מָע֑וֹן וּמָע֖וֹן אֲבִ֥י בֵֽית־צֽוּר׃

controles.web: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
controles.kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth–zur.
controles.livre: E o filho de Samai foi Maom, e Maom foi pai de Bete-Zur.

versos.hebraico: וְעֵיפָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ כָּלֵ֔ב יָֽלְדָ֛ה אֶת־חָרָ֥ן וְאֶת־מוֹצָ֖א וְאֶת־גָּזֵ֑ז וְחָרָ֖ן הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־גָּזֵֽז׃ס

controles.web: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
controles.kjv: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
controles.livre: E Efá, a concubina de Calebe, lhe gerou a Harã, Moza, e a Gazez. E Harã gerou a Gazez.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י יָהְדָּ֑י רֶ֧גֶם וְיוֹתָ֛ם וְגֵישָׁ֥ן וָפֶ֖לֶט וְעֵיפָ֥ה וָשָֽׁעַף׃

controles.web: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jothan, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Jadai foram: Regém, Jotão, Gesã, Pelete, Efá, e Saafe.

versos.hebraico: פִּלֶ֤גֶשׁ כָּלֵב֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה יָ֥לַד שֶׁ֖בֶר וְאֶֽת־תִּרְחֲנָֽה׃

controles.web: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
controles.kjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
controles.livre: Maaca, concubina de Calebe, lhe gerou a Seber, e a Tiraná.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֗לֶד שַׁ֚עַף אֲבִ֣י מַדְמַנָּ֔ה אֶת־שְׁוָ֛א אֲבִ֥י מַכְבֵּנָ֖ה וַאֲבִ֣י גִבְעָ֑א וּבַת־כָּלֵ֖ב עַכְסָֽה׃ס

controles.web: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
controles.kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
controles.livre: Ela também deu à luz a Saafe, pai de Madmana, e a Seva, pai de Macbena e pai de Gibeá. E a filha de Calebe foi Acsa.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י כָלֵ֔ב בֶּן־ח֖וּר בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֑תָה שׁוֹבָ֕ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃

controles.web: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
controles.kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim,
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Calebe, filho de Hur, primogênito de Efrata: Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim;

versos.hebraico: שַׂלְמָא֙ אֲבִ֣י בֵֽית־לָ֔חֶם חָרֵ֖ף אֲבִ֥י בֵית־גָּדֵֽר׃

controles.web: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
controles.kjv: Salma the father of Beth–lehem, Hareph the father of Beth–gader.
controles.livre: Salma, pai dos belemitas; e Harefe, pai de Bete-Gader.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בָנִים֙ לְשׁוֹבָ֔ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים הָרֹאֶ֖ה חֲצִ֥י הַמְּנֻחֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
controles.kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim foram: Haroé, a metade dos Manaatitas.

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַיִּתְרִי֙ וְהַפּוּתִ֔י וְהַשֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵאֵ֗לֶּה יָצְאוּ֙ הַצָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְהָאֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי׃ס

controles.web: The families of Kiriath Jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
controles.kjv: And the families of Kirjath–jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
controles.livre: E as famílias de Quiriate-Jearim foram os itreus, os puteus, os sumateus, e os misraeus; destes saíram os zorateus e os estaoleus.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שַׂלְמָ֗א בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ וּנְט֣וֹפָתִ֔י עַטְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֑ב וַחֲצִ֥י הַמָּנַחְתִּ֖י הַצָּרְעִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
controles.kjv: The sons of Salma; Beth–lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Salma foram: Belém, e os netofatitas, Atarote, Bete-Joabe; e da metade dos manaatitas, e os zoritas.

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת סֹפְרִים֙ ישבו יַעְבֵּ֔ץ תִּרְעָתִ֥ים שִׁמְעָתִ֖ים שׂוּכָתִ֑ים הֵ֚מָּה הַקִּינִ֣ים הַבָּאִ֔ים מֵחַמַּ֖ת אֲבִ֥י בֵית־רֵכָֽב׃ס

controles.web: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
controles.kjv: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
controles.livre: E as famílias dos escribas, que habitavam em Jabez, foram os tiratitas, os simeatitas, e os sucatitas; estes foram os queneus que vieram de Hamate, pai da casa de Recabe.
